% A test for tex8web: a document in XCharter, the charter package's Charter
% extended, with a passage in Times chosen in the text (\fontfamily), whose
% page shows them in XCharter and TeX Gyre's Termes. Its math stays in
% MathJax's TeX font, as the PDF's in Computer Modern.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{XCharter}
\begin{document}
Text in XCharter, \emph{in italics}, \textbf{in bold},
{\fontfamily{bch}\selectfont in Charter} and {\fontfamily{qtm}\selectfont in Termes},
with $x^2$ in math.
\end{document}
